scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm seed:plans && pnpm seed
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm plans:verify
scripts.seed: pnpm --filter @repo/api exec wrangler d1 execute chatform --local --file ../../tooling/seed.sql
scripts.seed:plans: pnpm --filter @repo/api exec wrangler d1 execute chatform --local --file ../../tooling/seed-plans.sql
scripts.seed:remote: pnpm --filter @repo/api exec wrangler d1 execute chatform --remote --file ../../tooling/seed.sql
scripts.seed:plans:remote: pnpm --filter @repo/api exec wrangler d1 execute chatform --remote --file ../../tooling/seed-plans.sql
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm --filter @repo/web run cf:build && pnpm --filter @repo/web run cf:deploy
